battleView.title: The battlefield
battleView.event.leaderDown: {squad} loses its leader: {fate, select, dead {slain} captured {taken alive} other {wounded}}.
battleView.event.raidTimerExpired: Time is up: back to the ships!
battleView.notice.selectFirst: Select one of your squads first (left-click, or a number key).
battleView.notice.pickEnemy: Click an enemy squad to charge.
battleView.notice.pickBuilding: Click a building or a gate.
battleView.raidTimerTip: When the horns sound, the countryside has gathered: every raider runs for the ships. Loot carried aboard by then is yours.
battleView.windTip: Wind strength {str}%. The arrow shows where it blows: fire spreads downwind and smoke drifts with it.
battleView.goal.attacker: {kind, select, raid {Plunder the buildings (gold marks) and carry the loot back to the ships (the blue-green shore) before the horns sound, or break the defenders.} assault {Kill or capture their chief, or break every squad that stands against you.} cloister {Break into the reliquary (crown mark), or scatter its guards.} fortress {Take the keep (crown mark) and hold it with no defender near.} field {Break the enemy army: rout or destroy every squad.} ambush {Fight your way clear: break the ambushers.} beach {Win the strand: break the defenders.} guardian {Break the guardians, or take and hold what they guard.} other {Break the enemy army.}}
battleView.goal.defender: {kind, select, raid {Protect the buildings and the loot; drive the raiders back to their ships.} defense {Keep your chief alive and break the attackers.} other {Hold your ground and break the attackers.}}
battleView.morale.title: Morale {m} (started at {start})
battleView.morale.state.wavering: Wavering: fights at {pct}% and may break.
battleView.morale.state.routing: Routing: running for safety, deaf to orders until it rallies.
battleView.morale.rule.waver: Below {at} a squad wavers and fights at {pct}%.
battleView.morale.rule.rally: A broken squad rallies at {at} once no enemy is near and its leader still stands.
battleView.morale.rule.causes: Morale falls with men lost (up to {losses} for a whole squad), smoke and fire ({fire} a second), the first blow on a flank or rear ({flank}), its leader falling ({leader}) and friends breaking nearby ({friends}). It recovers slowly when safe; Rally restores it.
battleView.order.fighting: In the fight{hasTarget, select, yes {: {target}} other {}}
battleView.order.gate: {planned, select, yes {Will break} other {Breaking}} the gate
battleView.tip.men: {lost} struck down so far, about {wounded} of them wounded rather than dead. One figure stands for five men.
battleView.tip.stamina: Running and fighting tire men; resting restores them. Below {low} they fight at {pct}%.
battleView.tip.loot: Silver carried, and what the squad can carry. Bring it to the ships to keep it; a squad that breaks drops it.
battleView.tip.health: Your own wounds. At zero you are carried off the field, or worse.
battleView.tip.burning: Burning ({pct}% burned): loot inside is being lost.
battleView.panel.none: Left-click a squad (or press 1 to 8) to command it. Drag a box to select several.
battleView.formationTip.line: Line: the steady default, a wide front.
battleView.formationTip.shieldWall: Shield wall: much harder to kill from the front and stops charges, but slow and cannot charge.
battleView.formationTip.wedge: Wedge: a narrow front that hits harder on the charge, weaker in defence.
battleView.formationTip.loose: Loose: spread out, quicker and safer from arrows, weaker in melee.
battleView.stanceTip.engage: Engage: when idle, attacks enemies who come close.
battleView.stanceTip.hold: Hold: never moves without orders and never pursues.
battleView.stanceTip.skirmish: Skirmish: when idle, backs away from enemies who close in (best for archers).
battleView.abilityTip.shieldWall: Lock shields (or open the wall again).
battleView.abilityTip.charge: Run at an enemy squad (click it) and strike with the weight of the charge. A shield wall in front stops it.
battleView.abilityTip.volley: Loose a volley at a spot (click it); with pitch aboard, the arrows burn.
battleView.abilityTip.torch: Set a building or gate on fire (click it). Fire spreads downwind.
battleView.abilityTip.ram: Batter a gate with the ram (click the gate).
battleView.abilityTip.rally: The leader steadies every squad near him (not while locked in melee).
battleView.abilityTip.frenzy: Berserk rage: hits much harder and feels no fear, but takes more blows and is spent afterwards.
battleView.abilityTip.hide: Melt into cover: unseen until enemies come very close.
battleView.abilityTip.challenge: Challenge their chief to single combat (you must be close to him).
battleView.abilityTip.douse: Beat out a fire (click the burning building).
battleView.target.charge: Click the enemy squad to charge. Right-click or Esc to cancel.
battleView.target.volley: Click where the volley should fall. Right-click or Esc to cancel.
battleView.target.torch: Click the building or gate to burn. Right-click or Esc to cancel.
battleView.target.douse: Click the burning building. Right-click or Esc to cancel.
battleView.target.ram: Click the gate to ram. Right-click or Esc to cancel.
battleView.howto.title: How to command
battleView.howto.intro: The battle waits for you: give orders now, then let it run. You can pause at any time.
battleView.howto.select: Select a squad (Shift adds). Double-click selects all of that kind; Ctrl+A selects everyone.
battleView.howto.box: Select every squad in the box.
battleView.howto.order: March there. On an enemy: attack. On a building with gold: plunder. On a gate: break it. Hold Ctrl to run.
battleView.howto.face: March to where the drag starts and face along it.
battleView.howto.queue: Add a waypoint after the current march.
battleView.howto.pause: Pause or resume. Orders given while paused show as bright lines and start when time runs.
battleView.howto.abilityKey: Q W E R T F
battleView.howto.ability: Shield wall, charge, volley or torch, rally, challenge, next formation. Backspace: fall back.
battleView.howto.camera: Zoom and pan (or drag with the middle button). Esc opens the battle menu.
battleView.howto.morale: Blue are yours, red the enemy. Under each name: morale (green, amber when wavering, red when breaking) and stamina. Hover a squad to see why its morale moves.
battleView.pausedBanner: Paused: press Space to fight on
battleView.captainsTip: Your squads fight on under your captains and the battle is played out at full speed. You see the outcome at once.
battleView.retreatConfirm.attacker: Every squad runs for the ships. Loot already aboard is kept; the field is lost.
battleView.retreatConfirm.defender: Every squad falls back from the field. The attackers win the day.
battleView.duel.title: Single combat!
battleView.duel.body: {challenger} and {chief} step out between the lines. Both armies hold their breath.
battleView.sum.loot: {value, plural, =0 {No loot carried off.} other {Loot carried off: worth # silver.}}
battleView.sum.goods: Goods: {list}{more, plural, =0 {} one {, and one more} other {, and # more}}.
battleView.sum.burned: {n, plural, one {One building burned.} other {# buildings burned.}}
battleView.hint.torch: With a squad selected, press E (Torch) and click it to burn it.
battleView.error.noResult: The battle has no result yet.
battleView.error.refused: The saga could not take this result: {message}
